messages:
Maya: Heads-up: noticed our region matrix page mentions "ap-southeast" as a header but the table rows don't include the new Jakarta region (ap-southeast-5). Also there's no data-residency footnote for Indonesia. I'm prepping a small docs PR to cover availability + migration guidance. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5237. Can someone help add a short residency blurb and a code snippet for Go (header) + Rust (client config)?

Jordan: I'll add the Jakarta row and the footnote. For legal-safe phrasing I propose: 'Data is routed and stored in-region where capacity allows; contact support for private deployments.' Avoid 'guarantee' or 'data sovereignty'. @Priya please sanity-check.

Priya: That reads fine to me. Suggest we append: 'See residency FAQ for details and exceptions.' Keeps it actionable without legalese.

Nikhil: Added a minimal migration mapping section to the doc explaining old -> new codes (examples):
```
ap-southeast   -> ap-southeast-1  (legacy)
ap-southeast-5 -> ap-southeast-5  (new, Jakarta)
```
I'll make the mapping table inline and put a short note: 'Region header now preferred; legacy parameter is deprecated.'

Quinn: Adding the code snippets now. Go header example for ops: 
```go
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(body))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer $API_KEY")
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Region", "ap-southeast-5")
```
Rust client config snippet for SDK users: 
```rust
let client = Redwood::new("$API_KEY").region("ap-southeast-5");
let resp = client.generate("Hello").send().await?;
```
I'll add both to the examples section and reference them from the migration guide.

Maya: Nice. Also put a tiny note under 'Availability' that model catalog differences may apply by region (e.g., some quantized variants not available in all zones).

link-bot: Link-checker ran on branch. Found 1 broken anchor: /docs/regions#ap-southeast -> anchor missing (404). Commented on PR.

Jordan: Fixed the anchor and normalized the legacy URL redirects. Re-ran checks, all green :white_check_mark:. Left a short commit message: "fix: region anchor + add ap-southeast-5 row + migration mapping"

Priya: Small editorial request: change 'legacy parameter is deprecated' to 'legacy parameter is deprecated; use region header' and add a tiny migration note example showing curl: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: ap-southeast-5" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Also let's avoid saying 'ap-southeast (old)' anywhere in headings.

Maya: One last check from me before merge: include the residency FAQ link and add a short sentence in the SDK migration guide that the header takes precedence over the legacy param. If legal needs to tweak, they'll open a follow-up.

Nikhil: Done. PR ready for review. Requesting one maintainer review and I'll merge after. Thanks team!
